summary: iter344 sprint verification (backend + frontend). Backend pytest: 12/13 passed, 1 skipped (register 500 on preview blocks fresh non-admin creation — non-admin bypass already asserted via buyer_token 401/403 test). Frontend: found and FIXED a CRITICAL blocker — AdminDashboard.js still checked `user.role === 'superadmin'` (no underscore) which contradicted the iter344 backend normalization to 'super_admin'. After adding `super_admin` to the isAdmin check (line 411), /admin loads and ALL flows verified: impersonation dropdown item + banner + exit, Reset Password toast 'Reset email sent', AdminLotEditorModal via edit-lots-btn, /admin/dialer renders without crash. ui_bugs.issue: P0 GATE MISMATCH — the frontend gate still checked `user.role === 'superadmin'` (no underscore) while the iter344 backend normalized the sole admin's role to `super_admin` (with underscore). Result: /admin redirected admin to '/' with 'You do not have permission to access this page'. FIXED by adding `user.role === 'super_admin'` to the OR chain. Admin now reaches /admin and all sprint flows are testable.

ui_bugs.issue: 10+ other locations still hard-code `user.role === 'superadmin'` (no underscore). These paths don't fully block /admin any more (the gate is fixed) but they still gate admin UI affordances: Navbar admin link (line 292, 321, 343, 356, 468), CreateListingPage `isAdminUser` (line 151), StorageHero/Browse/FooterBanner storage checks, and the AdminDashboard header badge (`👑 Super Admin` vs `⚡ Admin` at line 732 — currently shows `⚡ Admin` for super_admin because of the mismatch). Recommend a repo-wide replace: add `user.role === 'super_admin'` next to every `'superadmin'` check, or introduce a `isAdmin(user)` helper.

rca of the issue: Root cause of frontend admin-panel redirect loop: AdminDashboard.js `isAdmin` OR-chain (line 409-412) matched only `user.role === 'admin' || user.role === 'superadmin'` — the sprint spec normalized the sole admin's role to `super_admin` (underscore) in deps.py:110 but the frontend counterpart was never updated. Reproduction: log in as charbel911@gmail.com → /auth/me returns role=super_admin → navigate to /admin → useEffect fires → isAdmin is false → toast 'You do not have permission…' → navigate('/'). Mitigation applied: added `user.role === 'super_admin'` to the OR chain (in place, no restart needed since HMR). Long-term fix: introduce a single `isAdmin(user)` helper (or `roles.js` constants) so backend/frontend can't desync again.
